blocks.text: This Acceptable Use Policy ("Policy") outlines acceptable uses of Zscaler’s and its affiliates’ products, platforms, professional services, support services, consulting services, and any other services provided by or on behalf of Zscaler (collectively, "Offerings"), including any Outputs (as defined in the Product Output Disclaimer), deliverables, or recommendations generated in connection with such Offerings. In this Policy, "you" and "your" refer to the Customer as defined in the End User Subscription Agreement or the applicable agreement ("Agreement") between you and Zscaler. By accessing any Offerings, you agree to this Policy. This Policy is incorporated into, and subject to, the terms of your Agreement. We reserve the right to modify this Policy at any time.
You may not engage in any of the following:
1.1. Posting, transmitting, or storing content that is libelous, obscene, threatening, defamatory, or that infringes any intellectual property rights or violates any applicable law;
1.2. Reproducing, distributing, or creating derivative works from material obtained through the Offerings without required permissions from the rights holder;
1.3. Sending unsolicited bulk messages ("Spam"), or transmitting large volumes of duplicative, empty, or oversized messages that disrupt any service;
1.4. Harvesting email addresses, screen names, or other identifiers without prior consent, including through spidering or spyware;
1.5. Falsifying or removing message headers; or
1.6. Impersonating any person or entity, forging signatures, falsifying sender addresses, or engaging in phishing or similar fraudulent activity.

2.1. You may not access any computer, system, network, software, or data without the owner's consent, or attempt to breach or circumvent the security of any host, network, or account. You may not use or distribute security-compromising tools such as password guessing programs, keystroke loggers, packet sniffers, or Trojan Horse programs. Unauthorized port scanning is strictly prohibited. You may not copy, distribute, sublicense, or make unauthorized modifications to any Zscaler Offerings.

2.2. You may not interfere with any entity's use of the Offerings, including by transmitting malicious code or generating disruptive traffic levels. You may not degrade the performance of the Offerings or any Zscaler infrastructure through denial of service attacks, network flooding, service overloading, or any similar means.

3.1. This section governs your use of any Zscaler functionality powered by or incorporating artificial intelligence or machine learning (“AI Features”), including chatbots, policy recommendations, generative outputs, AI-assisted security assessments, AI red teaming tools (such as the SPLX platform). AI Features include AI-powered or AI-assisted capabilities whether embedded in Zscaler products, delivered through professional services, tech support, threat hunting, consulting, or otherwise made available by Zscaler personnel or contractors. Zscaler may introduce new or updated AI Features from time to time. Your use of such AI Features is automatically subject to this Policy upon its release, without the need for separate notice or consent.

3.2. AI Features rely on machine learning algorithms, large language models, and other advanced technology. They are not human, and their outputs may be incomplete, inaccurate, or inappropriate and should not be relied upon without independent verification. You are solely responsible for evaluating and verifying all AI-generated outputs before taking any action on them. See the Product Output Disclaimer for additional terms. For your privacy and security, do not share any personal or sensitive information.
3.3. When using AI Features you may not access, use, or enable others to access or use AI Features in any manner that would be in conflict with these rules:

3.3.1. Comply with applicable laws. Do not violate any applicable law including conduct that describes, supports, or distributes in any form child sexual abuse materials. Do not override safety or privacy filters, controls, or mechanisms.

3.3.2. Do not use AI Features to harm. Do not use AI Features to generate, facilitate, or distribute content that: (a) harms or threatens harm to any individual; (b) is sexually explicit or exploitative; (c) violates or infringes the rights of others; or (d) is intentionally or reasonably foreseeably misleading or deceptive. AI Features do not provide, and should not be treated as, medical, legal, financial, or any other kind of professional advisory services. If searching for important information, always verify the output with authoritative sources.

3.3.3. Do not misuse AI Features. Any attempts to exploit AI Features for malicious purposes like system interference, hacking or distributing malware are not allowed. Similarly, using AI Features for creating training data for other AI systems without Zscaler’s permission is not allowed. You may not reverse engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract the model weights, algorithms, or underlying architecture of any AI Features, or systematically probe AI Features to reconstruct their training data or decision logic.

3.3.4. Not designed nor intended for High Risk Activity. AI Features are not designed nor intended for any purpose requiring fail-safe performance, including stock trading, financial transaction processing, public transit systems, operation of nuclear facilities, electrical grid management, aircraft navigation or communication systems, air traffic control, life support machines, or weapons systems, or any other safety management or operation of critical infrastructure or hazardous applications for which failure could result in significant risk of death, personal injury, or severe physical, property, or environmental damage (each a “High Risk Activity”). Do not use any Offering or any of its AI Features as a safety component for any High Risk Activity.

3.4. AI Features’ Outputs are for general informational purposes only and should not be relied upon as the sole basis for any decision or action, including consequential decisions such as those impacting a person’s employment status, health, or safety. You are solely responsible for verifying Outputs before taking or refraining from taking any action.

3.4.1. Do not input sensitive information. Zscaler does not need or require sensitive personal information to provide AI Features. You and your users should not upload or input sensitive personal information into AI Features. Please ensure that your users abide by your internal data security and privacy policies. You are solely responsible for having appropriate internal policies regarding what types of information may and may not be submitted to AI Features. Zscaler shall not be liable for any loss, disclosure, or misuse of sensitive or confidential information that you or your users submit to AI Features in violation of your own policies or applicable law.

blocks.heading: 4. Right to Monitor and Terminate Access

blocks.text: 4.1. Zscaler reserves the right to monitor use of the Offerings and the right to suspend or terminate your access due to violation of this Policy.
